applies_to: Yaskawa E7 HVAC drives on Modbus RTU (MEMOBUS), read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the Yaskawa E7: 589 objects (72 AI, 310 AO, 187 BI, 20 BO), but only 50 polled by default (inverter status bits and the main monitors). Run/stop, direction, fault reset and multi-function input commands, the frequency reference and PID setpoint, fault contents bits and a long parameter list are in the profile but unpolled.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Yaskawa_E7_Drive_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the Yaskawa E7 Modbus technical manual (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/TME711.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 50 of the 589 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (Frequency Reference; PID Setpoint; Inverter Status Speed Agree...); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.

integration.summary: Enable and write the run command (BO 1) and frequency reference (AO 12) for control, then read the inverter status bits, output frequency, current and power.
integration.enable: The drive must take its run command and frequency reference from serial communication (b1-01 / b1-02 set to serial per the E7 manual) before BO 1 and AO 12 act. These command objects are unpolled in the published profile; tick them first.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Run, reference and reset objects are unpolled by default; enable them before mapping.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
